$comment: #EXP-1617 E4 part 4: THE REPO PAGE'S RUNS TAB AND ITS CI SETTINGS ×4 (repo-page.json's page; genUI catalogue components only, mockups approved). DATA: the synced `ci_runs` + `ci_jobs` of the repository (shapes ci-runs / ci-jobs), the repo row (provider, `ci_config` from tRPC `ci.repoSettings`) and its secret NAMES (`ci.repoSettings` → secrets [{name, updatedAt}]; values are never read back). RUNS TAB (replaces the EmptyState): `runRows(runs, jobs, now)` newest run number first, at most `limits.runs`: WIDE (web, desktop) a `Table` with the columns `copy.runs.columns` in that order (status = the glyph `Icon` tinted by its tone + `copy.status[status]`; run = `#n name`; commit = the sha's 7; ref; trigger = `copy.triggers[trigger]`; duration; started = relative time), PHONES one `Row` per run (leading glyph, identifier `#n`, title = name, subtitle = `ref · sha7 · trigger label`, meta = duration); a row or table row opens the run page (`/t/$teamSlug/ci/$runId`); no runs = `EmptyState` (repo-page.json `copy.runs.empty`). The status of a run is ci-run.json `runStatus` over its jobs; glyph/tone: queued → ci-queued muted, running → ci-running muted, passed → ci-passed green, failed → ci-failed red, cancelled → ci-skipped muted. Duration = pr-checks formatDuration of (completedAt or now) − startedAt, null before it started; ref = the run's ref, else copy.runs.noRef. SETTINGS TAB, a `Section` titled `copy.ci.section` after the repo's own rows: (1) the pipelines: `pipelineRows(runs, jobs)` = one `Row` per pipeline NAME (its newest run), title = the name, meta = a `Chip{dot}` of repo-page.json `copy.checks[state]` for that run's state (pending | success | failure); none = one muted `Text` copy.ci.noPipeline; (2) `copy.ci.required.label` as a `SettingsRow` holding a `ChipInput` (values = ci_config.requiredChecks, suggestions = `requiredSuggestions`, placeholder copy.ci.required.placeholder) writing `ci.setRepoConfig{requiredChecks}`; (3) `copy.ci.secrets.title`: WIDE a `Table` (columns copy.ci.secrets.columns: name, updated) PHONES `Row`s (title = name, meta = updated, relative), each with a delete action (`AlertDialog` copy.ci.secrets.deleteTitle / deleteConfirm → `ci.deleteSecret`), then a `Button` copy.ci.secrets.add opening a `Dialog` (phones: a `Drawer`) with an `Input` copy.ci.secrets.name (validated by `secretName`, invalid = inline copy.ci.secrets.invalid), an `Input{type:password}` copy.ci.secrets.value and `FormActions` (copy.ci.secrets.cancel / copy.ci.secrets.save → `ci.setSecret`); none = muted `Text` copy.ci.secrets.empty; (4) `switches(provider)` as `SettingsRow` + `Switch` each (label/description from copy.ci[switch]), writing `ci.setRepoConfig{githubStatuses | actionsRunners}`. Only the repo's managers (the member who shared it, or a team owner) can change anything: for others every control is disabled and the secret actions are hidden. Replayed by packages/domain-contract (bun test), desktop domain::repo_ci, iOS ExpCore RepoCi, Android domain RepoCi: every mirror replays runRows, pipelineRows, requiredSuggestions, secretName and switches, comparing the WHOLE result.
